why_it_matters: The whole point of the stream is promptness: without it a fill is learned at the next reconciliation rather than when it happens. Note `Status` here is TITLE CASE ("Cancelled") in Dhan's own sample while the parameter table on the same page lists the enum in UPPER CASE, and the REST order book returns upper -- so a reader keyed on one case sees no status at all from the other. `TxnType`, `Product` and `OrderType` are all abbreviated differently from REST too: B/S, C/I/M/F/V/B, and LMT/MKT/SL/SLM.
docs_sample_does_not_parse: Four defects in Dhan's own JSON sample: `"AlgoOrdNo": ,` and `"StrikePrice": ,` have no value, `"multiplier": 1` has no trailing comma, and `Remarks` appears TWICE in one object. The two missing values are null here and the second `Remarks` is kept, since it is the one carrying "Super Order".
